lemma: finite index between the reference lattice and O^n gives the volume conversion
statement: K/Q_p finite; O its ring of integers; Lambda an O-lattice with O^n and Lambda mutually contained in K^n
hypotheses: vol_Lambda = [O^n : Lambda] * vol_{O^n} under one Haar measure
proof_draft: Hecke index formula + multiplicativity of Haar measure over a finite-index subgroup; O is Z_p-free of rank [K:Q_p]
possible_failure: Lambda only K-isomorphic to O^n with infinite index: the factor is then infinite and no conversion exists
needed_source_evidence: does III Remark 3.9.5(i) fix the reference lattice at all? if not, this hypothesis is mine and must be labelled new

lemma: the common container is A + B, and it need not be of the form lambda*O for n >= 2
statement: A, B are O-lattices in K^n
hypotheses: the least O-lattice containing both is A+B, which is free over the DVR O
proof_draft: A+B contains both; any O-submodule containing both contains A+B; over a DVR submodules of K^n are free
possible_failure: for n >= 2, A+B is in general NOT of the form lambda*O^n, so 'the container is lambda*O' needs an extra hypothesis
needed_source_evidence: is the paper lambda*O componentwise (lambda = (lambda_i), each nonzero) or a single element?

lemma: the pulled-back container equals the original hull exactly when no component collapses
statement: n >= 1; lambda = (lambda_1,...,lambda_n) with every component nonzero; hull := prod_i lambda_i O; C a pulled-back container
hypotheses: C = hull iff the projection of C to every component is lambda_i O
proof_draft: forward from C subset hull plus equality of free ranks; backward by comparing generators componentwise
possible_failure: if some lambda_i = 0 the pulled-back container degenerates and the two sides differ in rank
needed_source_evidence: quote the sentence in III Remark 3.9.5(i) that excludes zero components, so the condition is sourced

lemma: normalised volume of the container against the original log-volume
statement: L1 index I finite; Haar measure mu with mu(O^n) = 1
hypotheses: vol_orig(lambda O^n) = -log_p |I| - sum_i log_p |lambda_i|_p after aligning mu with the original log-volume
proof_draft: multiplicativity gives mu(lambda O^n) = prod |lambda_i|_p; the index correction |I|_p comes from L1
possible_failure: the original log-volume need not use the same normalisation; a non-p-power discrepancy introduces an irrational factor (same gap as N06-10)
needed_source_evidence: which lattice has measure 1 in the original log-volume definition?

lemma: all allowed changes descend to one finite quotient
statement: every allowed change maps the reference lattice O^n to itself, i.e. G <= Aut(O^n)
hypotheses: G acts on O^n/p^k O^n and this action is compatible with the action on the container
proof_draft: well-definedness from preserving p^k O^n; compatibility because the action commutes with inclusion
possible_failure: N05 records shared_finite_quotient as UNRESOLVED for every paper item; if some allowed change does not preserve the lattice, the hypothesis fails
needed_source_evidence: III 3.11 Ind1/Ind2/Ind3: is there any source sentence saying they preserve one finite quotient?
